title: Filter My Events by Status (Organiser)
note: Jira is the source for AC1-AC7. Confluence matrix 28803536 (Filter My Events by Status (Organiser) Matrix) was created 18 Oct 2026 with 17 test cases FILTER-EVT-01-A through FILTER-EVT-07-A. The scope covers the four files with new or substantially changed SPM-95 logic: organiserStatusFilter.ts (new), StatusLabels.tsx (safetyCheckReady predicate added, Awaiting Equipment Request branch for empty equipment removed), StatusIndicators.tsx (SafetyIndicator now uses safetyCheckReady), and EventListPage.tsx (organiser CheckboxGroup filter). EventCard.tsx and EventDetailPage.tsx each had only 2-3 lines removed (AssignmentIndicator usage) and are excluded: their coverage is owned by SPM-94 (the reassignedFrom branches in EventCard are pre-existing SPM-94 code). AC6 (only own events shown) is server-enforced by SPM-38; the frontend test FILTER-EVT-06-A verifies that filtering makes no additional API request, which is the correct frontend gate for a server-side authz boundary. The mutants in spm95.mutants.mjs are M1-M8 covering the empty-set guard, OR vs AND logic, safetyCheckReady gate, AWAITING_CHECK indicator check, safetyCheckReady no-equipment vacuous truth, active-filter display, no-match message, and useState local reset semantics.
